description: Grassland Productivity Forecast (Grass-Cast) is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Colorado State University; National Drought Mitigation Center; University of Arizona. Every spring, ranchers face the same difficult challenge, trying to guess how much grass will be available for livestock to graze during the upcoming summer. This forecast tool can help producers in the Great Plains reduce this economically important source of uncertainty. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Drought, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
